title: Talleres and Rosario Central face off in the Argentine Championship
seoTitle: Talleres vs Rosario Central: Argentine League
subtitle: The teams take the field this Monday in the national competition.
excerpt: Details of the match between Talleres and Rosario Central in the sixth round of the Argentine Championship, including history and line‑ups.
author: Daniele Morais

contentHtml:
The teams Talleres and Rosario Central take the field this Monday to contest the sixth round of the Argentine Championship, stirring fans and generating searches about the showdown. The clash kicks off at 21:15 Brasília time at the Mario Alberto Kempes Stadium in Córdoba, Argentina.

Current situation of Talleres

Talleres is looking to bounce back after a run of unfavorable results in the competition. The side has lost four of its last five league matches, suffering defeats to Gimnasia Mendoza, Lanús and Vélez Sarsfield. Despite the unstable phase, the home performance brings hope, as the club has won four of seven games played in front of its supporters in the Apertura and Clausura.

Rosario Central's moment

Conversely, Rosario Central comes off a Libertadores elimination by Corinthians and now focuses entirely on the national league. The team has amassed three consecutive victories in the Professional League Clausura, beating River Plate, Aldosivi and Barracas Central. As a visitor, the club shows a solid record with four wins in eight matches.

Head‑to‑head history and statistics

The rivalry between the clubs is extremely balanced. In 42 encounters, there are 15 wins for Rosario Central, 12 draws and 15 triumphs for Talleres. Recent meetings tend to be high‑scoring, registering an average of 2.67 goals per game in the last nine clashes.

Probable line‑ups

The likely starting eleven for Talleres includes Ezequiel Unsain, Augusto Schott, Santiago Fernández, Valentín Frascendini, Alexandro Maidana, Timoteo Chamorro, Matías Galarza, Franco Cristaldo, Rick, Valentín Dávila and Valentín Depietri, under coach Jorge Sampaoli.

Rosario Central’s probable lineup should feature Jeremías Ledesma, Emanuel Coronel, Ignacio Ovando, Gastón Ávila, Agustín Sández, Franco Ibarra, Federico Navarro, Giovanni Cantizano, Ángel Di María, Jáminton Campaz and Enzo Copetti, coached by Jorge Almirón.

Where to watch the match

The Argentine Championship fixture will not be broadcast in Brazil. The organizers emphasize that the game has no live television transmission in Brazil.

With information from Gazeta Esportiva.
